# `app.graycard.catalog.devRecipe`

A development recipe: the time(s) to develop a given film at a given exposure index in a given developer/dilution, sourced from a manufacturer datasheet. Bundled curated recipes and user-saved personal recipes share this shape.

- **Source:** `lexicons/app/graycard/catalog/devRecipe.json`
- **Lexicon version:** `1`
- **Definitions:** 3

<a id="temppoint"></a>

## `tempPoint`

A published development time at one temperature. Times are only ever shown for temperatures a manufacturer datasheet supports (interpolated within published points, never extrapolated).

**Kind:** `object`

### Resolved fields

Referenced object fields are expanded once. A linked type name opens the definition that supplies the field.

| Field     | Required | Type / resolved ref | Constraints                         | Known values | Description                                               |
| --------- | -------- | ------------------- | ----------------------------------- | ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `tempC10` | yes      | `integer`           | `minimum=-1000`<br />`maximum=1000` |              | Temperature in tenths of a degree Celsius (20.0 C = 200). |
| `timeSec` | yes      | `integer`           | `minimum=0`<br />`maximum=604800`   |              | Development time in seconds at this temperature.          |
